name: Australian Postal Deliveries
description: Mail to a box, a bag or a rural service instead of a street: AS4590's postal delivery types (PO Box, GPO Box, Locked Bag, Private Bag, RMB, RSD, RMS, CMB, CMA, CPA, MS and Care PO), each reported in Australia Post's form in secUnitType with its number in secUnitNum, and the spellings people use for them. Original cases written for this corpus from Australia Post's guidelines and AS4590, described in our own words; nothing copied.
